properties.description:
Twenty-one tests across two files. `crates/reflow2-core/tests/an_upstream_design_is_watched_not_imported.rs` (14) pins the JUDGEMENT, which is pure: unchanged, moved, never_seen, missing, unreadable, graph_id_mismatch, not_watched, not_observed, and the manifest round trip. `crates/reflow2-mcp/tests/an_upstream_export_is_read_without_being_imported.rs` (7) pins the half only a filesystem can answer.

⭐ THE TWO THAT CARRY THE FEATURE. `reading_never_updates_the_baseline_so_a_move_keeps_being_reported` reads three times and asserts the STORED hash is untouched, not merely that the report repeats — a check that refreshed its own baseline would report a move once and then be permanently quiet, which is worse than no check because the silence reads as agreement. `reading_an_upstream_does_not_pull_a_single_node_into_this_design` asserts the node count is unchanged, that a node existing only upstream is absent here, and that this design still carries its own graph_id — because the failure an import produces is subtler than extra nodes: the host keeps its name and the upstream's content arrives under it.

`a_stale_self_stamp_does_not_hide_a_real_change` appends a node to an export by hand WITHOUT restamping — the shape a merge produces — and asserts the computed hash moves anyway. That is `sync_debt`'s 2026-08-11 defect written as a test before it could happen again here.

FOUND A REAL DEFECT WHILE BEING WRITTEN, fixed at the cause rather than in the test: `an_unwatched_dependency_emits_no_watch_fields_at_all` failed on a leftover `design_export_seen_at`, which is a baseline date for a target nobody named — a record of a check that never happened, reading to anyone scanning the manifest exactly like one that did. The hash and its date are now stored and emitted only inside the path.
properties.findings:
GREEN, and read from cargo's OWN exit code rather than from a pipe: `cargo test --workspace` exit 0, 165 suites, 1856 passed, 0 failed. The 21 tests of this check are inside that. Ran under `systemd-run --user --scope -p MemoryMax=6G` with output to a file, because `cargo test | grep | sort | head` returns head's exit code and says nothing about cargo — a trap this project has hit repeatedly.

🛑 AND A GREEN `cargo test` IS NOT A GREEN CI, which this run proved again: `cargo fmt --all -- --check` FAILED at exit 1 on three reflowed `if let` chains while all 1856 tests passed. Fixed and re-verified at exit 0. Every other gate CI runs was then run locally and is green: `skill_lint` (all checks, including the description cap that had already caught this feature's first tool description at 1569 chars against a 1500 limit), `smoke_mcp` against the real binary over stdio, `validate_schema`, `test_init` (100 tests), and `cargo clippy -p reflow2-core --no-default-features --all-targets` with zero warnings.

`toolsnap.py` reported the two intended surface changes — `declare_dependency` gaining `design_export` and `design_export_seen_at`, and the new `upstream_status` tool with no golden — and the goldens were regenerated deliberately with `--update` and re-checked clean.

⚠️ ONE ORDERING MISTAKE WORTH RECORDING: the artifact baselines were taken BEFORE `cargo fmt` ran, so three of them were stale within minutes and had to be retaken as `design_holds`. Format first, then baseline.
properties.name: A declared upstream is read and compared without being imported
